title: Ship-weekly-takeaways-and-actions
content:
Purpose / quick brain dump:
- Prep for Thu release-train sync (11:00). Personal checklist + talking points to avoid repeating past miscoordination. Mostly a scratchpad, will pull high-priority items into the huddle doc.
- Goal this week: cut v1.12 canary, validate latency on dedicated pool, and confirm fallback routing for model-bump.

Agenda notes (for myself):
- Quick status round-robin (30s per owner)
  - infra: capacity and DB replica syncs
  - serving-runtime: canary deployment health + KV cache priming
  - product: feature-flag gating and telemetry checks
  - QA: critical E2E smoke pass, perf threshold checks
- Go/No-Go call: we need explicit YES from SRE, QA lead, and Product PM
- Post-deploy rollback window & comms owner

Go/No-Go quick checklist (my shorthand, bring to meeting):
- SRE: cluster CPU < 70% w/ canary traffic, autoscaler tested = Owner: Leo Park (ENG-5123) — STATUS: waiting metrics
- DB migrations: backward compatible, zero-downtime path validated = Owner: Asha Patel — STATUS: migration script reviewed; dry-run scheduled 2/19
- Smoke tests: 3 critical flows passing (auth, inference, billing) = Owner: QA (Maya) — STATUS: smoke suite green locally, flakiness on staging noted
- Telemetry: tracing enabled + sampling rates set = Owner: DevOps — STATUS: incomplete (need sampling bump)
- Fallbacks: model-variant available in us-west and eu-central = Owner: Serving Runtime (Priya) — STATUS: partial (eu variant missing quantized build)
- Legal/privacy: no new PII exposure = Owner: Legal (Sam) — STATUS: green
- Opt-out list and admin kill-switch: documented and tested = Owner: Product Ops — STATUS: TODO

Top blockers / risks to call out:
- Quantized build for eu-central missing: increases risk of degraded latency post-cutover. If not resolved, plan: route eu users to compatible variant with slightly higher cost. Question: can we enable temporary hood for EU traffic? (ask Priya)
- Staging flakiness: intermittent 502s in staging during long sequences. Possible root cause: prefix cache eviction. Action: add temporary KV cache limit, monitor TTBR. Owner: Jordan (me) + serving-runtime eng.
- Autoscaler cold-start spikiness: observed 2x latency when burst > 250 concurrent requests during last test. Mitigation: pre-warm 2 extra nodes for first 30 mins of rollout. Owner: Leo.

Personal follow-ups (who I will ping after the sync):
- @Leo: ask for recent CPU/mem graphs (last 48h) and permission to pre-warm nodes.
- @Asha: confirm migration dry-run results and attach migration log to REL-2025.
- @Maya (QA): get exact failed test ids from the last run, triage flakiness vs real failure.
- @Priya: ETA on eu-central quantized build. If > 24h, set fallback routing plan B.
- Product Ops: draft comms for customer success + status page blurb (owner: Tessa)

Dispatch list (what to say during meeting, with owners):
- "SRE: do we have green on pre-warm config?" — Leo
- "QA: are those staging failures repeatable? block?" — Maya
- "Serving: can you confirm eu quantized build timeline?" — Priya
- "Product: are feature flags gated correctly for the canary cohort?" — Tessa
- "Legal: any last-minute checks on telemetry?" — Sam

Rollback & Post-deploy play (short form):
- If errors spike > 5% p50->p95 increase, or error budget > 3% in first 20m, initiate rollback.
- Rollback owner: Leo (SRE). Communications: Tessa to notify support and execs.
- Post-deploy check at +10m, +30m, +2h. Owners: Jordan (10m), QA lead (30m), Product (2h)

Notes to self / undecided items to bring up:
- Do we want to enable the new batching heuristic for the canary? Pros: lower tokens/unit cost. Cons: unknown impact on tail latency. If yes, include as canary-only config with immediate opt-out flag.
- Do we include the new streaming API in this release or postpone? I lean postpone (not critical path).
- Confirmation required on retention policy for new debug traces (compliance ask) — Sam to confirm.

Meeting prep checklist (my day-of tasks):
- [ ] Pull SLO/SLA dashboards and snapshot last 24h (dashboard: infra/slo/overview)
- [ ] Run quick smoke on staging and capture logs for any 502s
- [ ] Update REL-2025 ticket with today notes and link smoke logs
- [ ] Draft short status paragraph for Slack #release-updates (2 lines)
- [ ] Upload canary config diff to PR: https://github.com/redwood/serve/pull/2345 (check CI green)

After-meeting action items (copy to personal TODO):
- Asha: finalize migration rollback test and post result — due 2025-02-19
- Leo: pre-warm nodes + share metrics screenshot — due 2025-02-19 09:00 PT
- Priya: either deliver eu quantized build or enable fallback routing — due 2025-02-19 EOD
- Maya: stabilize smoke suite on staging and rerun full regression — due 2025-02-20
- Jordan (me): if staging 502 persists, trigger hotfix branch and run targeted isolation tests — due 2025-02-19 morning

Random scratch / brain dump: 
- Remember to ask about on-call rotation for the day-of deploy (who covers 2h post-deploy).
- Consider adding a short canary-experiment note in product analytics to track UX regressions.
- Long-term: need a small automation to snapshot canary traffic split + deployed variant hashes — avoid manual mismatch. Ticket idea: ENG-5200.

End of notes. Will clean up and paste into the shared runbook if we get green checks across the core Go/No-Go items.

-- Jordan
